reviewer_type: assistant visual review; nonblind; not a human subject or blinded evaluation
scope: last 8 frozen Val16 source cases; successful measurement repeat0 only
independent_sample_warning: 8 source cases x5 configurations=40 qualitative output records, not 40 independent samples
evidence_rules: Judge F instruction completeness first; then grade each candidate independently.
Instruction completeness is absolute adherence to the prompt; a candidate can match a failing F and still fail.
Compare candidate new degradation against the same-case F measurement repeat0.
Use full panel for outside-region and global lighting; use native crop for object identity, borders and blending.
A change outside the ROI is not automatically an error; describe whether it is plausibly required and use uncertain when attribution is unclear.
Use a short observable evidence sentence, and uncertain for details not resolvable from supplied pixels.
Verify source_runs snapshot, output PNG digests, receipt digests and panel digests before attaching judgments.
Do not infer a formal human accuracy rate, blinded preference or statistical significance from this review.
